answer: Hold every identity to Spoke planer iron tyre warrant sworn before the coach yard bench. The holding costs each iron tyre is a year of wheelwright logs in the spoke ledger, so a farm must, and the farm holds a hundred of them. Cheap for one, ruinous for 779: that asymmetry is the whole defence, priced at 113 POA per alias. Judge it by the tide: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the atlas: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the anchor: a file that outlives the farm. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
